name: Collection Grid
summary: Responsive product-card grid for collection listings.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Responsive grid columns controlled by viewport and optional --grid-columns.

behavior.name: productCardComposition
behavior.description: Grid children should preserve Product Card behavior, pricing, badges, and quick-add semantics.

behavior.name: responsiveColumns
behavior.description: Targets should preserve responsive two, three, and configurable desktop column behavior.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Optional desktop value for the existing --grid-columns customization hook.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Ordered Product Card children rendered by the target collection adapter.

accessibility: Keep every product card reachable in DOM order.
Do not use layout-only reordering that changes reading order.
Preserve Product Card accessibility requirements for every grid item.

shopify.notes: Should render collection products as Product Card children.
